**Finding: missing (high severity) — no customer termination-for-convenience right.**

Section 11.1 commits Corio to a five-year initial term with automatic one-year renewals, and Section 11.2 allows termination only for uncured material breach or insolvency. Corio therefore has no convenience exit during a multi-year term and no refund of prepaid license/support fees — a missing-behaviour deviation under T4C. Commerce One likewise has no mid-term convenience right, so no deletion was needed on that side.

Redline (validated, preferred position): new Section 11.4 granting Corio convenience termination on 30 days' written notice, with no early-termination fee and a pro-rata refund of prepaid license, support and maintenance fees, and confirming Commerce One has no convenience right during the initial or renewal terms. Fallback offered in the comment: 60 days' notice.
